ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a visible macro-ratio of approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal lobes to 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white fields occupy the outer two-thirds of both the left and right lobes; a low-intensity black central corridor extends vertically from the peduncle, branching slightly at the notch; irregular dark mottling is present at the transition zones between black and white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees; notch depth is roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing edge boundary; distinct clusters of sharper peaks are visible on the interior trailing edge of the left lobe near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave sweep along the trailing edges, terminating in sharp upward convex curves at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-intensity dark pixel clusters (3-5 pixels in diameter) localized on the white distal field of the right lobe and along the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, irregular indentation or 'nick' on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced upward-tapering 'hook' geometry of the distal tips; high level of salt-and-pepper sensor noise present across the entire fluke surface.
